top: Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him,
bottom: saying, I will; be thou clean.

top: A bruised reed shall he not break,
bottom: and smoking flax shall he not quench...

top: when he had found one pearl of great price,
bottom: went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

top: And immediately Jesus stretched forth
bottom: his hand, and caught him...

top: For where two or three are gathered together
bottom: in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

top: the Son of man came not to be ministered unto,
bottom: but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

top: Render therefore unto Cæsar the things...
bottom: and unto God the things that are God's.

top: But he that shall endure unto the end,
bottom: the same shall be saved.

top: O my Father... nevertheless
bottom: not as I will, but as thou wilt.

top: And, behold, the veil of the temple
bottom: was rent in twain from the top to the bottom...

top: For whosoever shall do the will of God,
bottom: the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

top: Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole;
bottom: go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

top: Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place,
bottom: and rest a while...

top: Whosoever will come after me, let him deny
bottom: himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

top: Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God
bottom: as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

top: My house shall be called of all nations
bottom: the house of prayer...

top: love the Lord thy God with all thy heart,
bottom: and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind...

top: And the gospel must first be published
bottom: among all nations.

top: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter
bottom: that he goeth before you into Galilee...

top: Behold the handmaid of the Lord;
bottom: be it unto me according to thy word.

top: He that hath two coats, let him impart
bottom: to him that hath none...

top: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me...
bottom: to preach deliverance to the captives...

top: But love ye your enemies, and do good,
bottom: and lend, hoping for nothing again...

top: And stood at his feet behind him weeping,
bottom: and began to wash his feet with tears...

top: No man, when he hath lighted a candle...
bottom: setteth it on a candlestick...

top: Our Father which art in heaven,
bottom: Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.

top: Strive to enter in
bottom: at the strait gate...

top: If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed,
bottom: ye might say unto this sycamine tree...

top: ...but smote upon his breast, saying,
bottom: God be merciful to me a sinner.

top: For he is not a God of the dead,
bottom: but of the living: for all live unto him.

top: then look up, and lift up your heads;
bottom: for your redemption draweth nigh.

top: I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not:
bottom: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

top: Verily I say unto thee, To day
bottom: shalt thou be with me in paradise.

top: Did not our heart burn within us,
bottom: while he talked with us by the way...

top: the water that I shall give him shall be in him
bottom: a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

top: Jesus saith unto him,
bottom: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

top: and him that cometh to me
bottom: I will in no wise cast out.

top: If any man thirst,
bottom: let him come unto me, and drink.

top: Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground...
bottom: if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

top: In my Father's house are many mansions...
bottom: I go to prepare a place for you.

top: Sanctify them through thy truth:
bottom: thy word is truth.

top: Lord, thou knowest all things;
bottom: thou knowest that I love thee... Feed my sheep.

top: Him hath God exalted with his right hand
bottom: to be a Prince and a Saviour...

top: being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly
bottom: into heaven, and saw the glory of God...
